encounter: P12 play_order 133, E0159 TRAINER_ROMAN, Ashen Woods, cap 42
availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Ashen Woods is reached in C24, immediately after Flannery's Heat Badge (cap 42) and the Go-Goggles handoff. A player standing in Ashen Woods has already walked Routes 101-104, Petalburg Woods, Rustboro, Route 116, Rusturf Tunnel, Granite Cave, Dewford and its meadow/manor, Slateport, Route 110, Mauville and its Game Corner, Route 117, Verdanturf, Routes 111/112/113/114, Fiery Path, Meteor Falls, Mt. Chimney, Jagged Pass and Ember Path. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map on that list. New Mauville and Route 118 sources are excluded (both need Surf, which Norman grants in C27, after this battle). No legendary or mythical is used; Kartana is an Ultra Beast, which the brief permits above the cap-24 window, and it is a native Petalburg Woods wild encounter reached in C05.
plan: Roman is two Rock/Ground bodies (Golem, Rhydon) plus Buzzwole and a Focus Sash Starmie. Grass is 4x into both rocks and Rillaboom supplies it as priority under its own terrain; Kartana supplies it at speed and resists Rock Slide. Togekiss is immune to both Ground attacks, takes Close Combat at 0.25x and Lunge at 0.5x, and redirects single-target damage off Kartana. Incineroar's Intimidate cuts an all-physical team except Starmie, and Fake Out denies a turn. Mega Gardevoir is the special answer to Buzzwole and the Sash-independent spread. Amoonguss holds Spore for the Buzzwole that Beast Boosts.
